lewis-four-examples.alt: Four Lewis diagrams. H2O: O bonded to two H atoms with two lone pairs on O, 8 valence electrons. NH3: N bonded to three H atoms with one lone pair on N, 8 valence electrons. CO2: C double-bonded to two O atoms, each O with two lone pairs, 16 valence electrons. NH4+: N bonded to four H atoms with no lone pairs, in brackets with a plus charge, 8 valence electrons.
